detail: do_re_enable never confirms the app belongs to the URL's vacancy; do_skip and handle_update_status both do (via get_application_reference_data / get_application_detail, whose SQL WHERE a.vacancy_id = $3). verify_application_ownership still blocks cross-tenant access, so a mismatched URL vacancy_id only bypasses the archived-vacancy guard for the landlord's own app.
recommended_fix: Pass vacancy_uuid into do_re_enable and call get_application_reference_data (or an equivalent app-vacancy join) before find_skipped_row_for_slot, mirroring do_skip, so a mismatched URL vacancy_id yields a branded 404.
